主要内容: On February 28, 2017, Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. appointed Kathy Yi as Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, effective the same date. Ms. Yi, 45, has over 15 years of experience in corporate finance, including roles at Novartis, Life Technologies, and Intel. She succeeded H. Ward Wolff, who retired as Executive Vice President and CFO. Ms. Yi received a stock option to purchase 200,000 shares at the closing price on February 28, 2017. The option vests 25% after one year and 75% over 36 months. In case of termination without cause or resignation for good reason within 12 months of a change in control, she will receive six months of base salary plus annual bonus. Unvested shares vest 50% if a change in control occurs within two years or 100% thereafter. Mr. Wolff’s post-termination exercise period for stock options was extended to two years following his retirement. These changes are detailed in the Yi Employment Agreement, to be filed as an exhibit to the Company’s 10-Q report for the period ending March 31, 2017.
